hooks.command: pnpm lint 2>&1; ec=$?; [ $ec -ne 0 ] && printf '{"continue":false,"stopReason":"Lint failed — run pnpm lint to fix errors before committing."}' || true; exit $ec

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command'); branch=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); if [ "$branch" = "main" ] || echo "$cmd" | grep -qE '( |:)main( |$)'; then printf '{"continue":false,"stopReason":"Direct pushes to main are not allowed — open a pull request instead."}'; exit 1; fi; git fetch origin 2>&1 && git rebase origin/main 2>&1; ec=$?; [ $ec -ne 0 ] && printf '{"continue":false,"stopReason":"Rebase onto origin/main failed — resolve conflicts before pushing."}' || true; exit $ec
hooks.statusMessage: Checking branch + rebasing onto origin/main before push…
